description: Synthetic retrieval eval for search_memory (no personal data). Each pair's target is the id of the item that answers the query; the other items are distractors.

items.text: User prefers answers formatted as short bullet lists
The team standup happens every weekday at 9:30 in the small meeting room
Default Python environment for analysis scripts is the conda env named analysis
User's preferred plotting library is matplotlib with the seaborn whitegrid style
Backups of the project share run nightly at 2am to the offsite storage bucket
The shared GPU workstation is called workstation-a and needs a booking in the calendar
User writes papers in LaTeX using Overleaf and keeps references in Zotero
Vacation days must be requested two weeks ahead through the HR portal
The lab coffee fund is collected on the first Monday of every month
Use metric units and ISO 8601 dates in every report
The printer on the second floor jams with heavy cardstock paper
Grant reports are due at the end of each quarter
execute_command: rsync with a trailing slash copies the directory contents, not the directory itself
read_file: PDF files must be converted with pdftotext before reading their text
execute_command: pip install fails behind the proxy unless HTTPS_PROXY is exported
edit_file: the search text must match the file exactly including indentation
web_search: put exact error messages in quotes to find matching forum threads
execute_command: tar archives need the -z flag for gzip compression
execute_command: git push is rejected when the branch is behind, pull with rebase first
execute_command: docker containers lose their files on restart unless a volume is mounted
fetch_webpage: sites behind a login return the sign-in page instead of the content
execute_command: crontab entries need absolute paths because cron has a minimal PATH

Use pandas read_csv and then to_excel with openpyxl installed

Use ImageMagick mogrify -resize 50% on the folder

The dashboard listens on port 8050

Use du -ah | sort -h | tail or the ncdu tool

what is the wifi password for guests
The guest network uses the code printed on the router label

how do I undo the last git commit but keep changes
Use git reset --soft HEAD~1
